The image shows soybean seeds held in a hand. Several seeds display distinct pink to purple discoloration on their seed coats, while others appear normal yellow/cream. This is the defining symptom of Purple Seed Stain caused by *Cercospora kikuchii*.

Key evidence:
- **Affected plant part**: Seeds (seed coats)
- **Color**: Purple/violet blotches on otherwise normal-colored soybean seeds
- **Pattern**: Irregular purple staining on seed coat surface — exactly matching the description "pink to purple discoloration on seed coats of infected seeds"
- No other class involves purple seed coat discoloration
